title: Four metric comparisons
caption: Independent scales; n/N = scored / eligible. Epistemic means describe only the scored subset; unresolved answers can include errors and correct paraphrases. ER is a filler parser proxy.

title: Coverage and missingness
caption: Grey remainder = unscored eligible attempts, including errors, limits, or unresolved judgments. Read this before conditional means.

title: Negative adherence by category
caption: Only declared prohibitions are checked; grey cells have no scored replies. n/N exposes measurement coverage.

title: Repeated-prompt variance
caption: Mean within-prompt sample variance across prompts with at least two scored repeats. Low variance measures stability, not correctness; no confidence intervals are implied.

title: Observed response latency
caption: Box = interquartile range; center = median; whiskers extend to 1.5 IQR. Different sizes/default thinking make this unequal-compute timing evidence.
